Consequently, the Planner set the incorrect director (Barry Sonnenfeld) as the target to verify, leading to a failed search strategy and an incorrect final answer when the system eventually had to rely on the Wikipedia page (which correctly identified Brad Silberling) but the Planner had already committed to the wrong name in its internal logic.
